name: justcode
description: Single-machine LeetCode clone with Java execution support

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/dist frontend/dist frontend/.vite temp backend/temp backend/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo frontend/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo frontend/tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo
scripts.clean:build: rimraf backend/dist frontend/dist frontend/.vite backend/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo frontend/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo frontend/tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --incremental false --composite false
